name: Compare platform and total cost of ownership
what: Compares Shopify, WooCommerce and a custom or headless build against the brand's catalogue size, budget and design needs, and picks the platform and plan tier with the lowest true cost, not the lowest sticker price.
encompasses: List required theme features before comparing platforms
Score hosting, apps, transaction fees and dev time as one cost
Recommend a plan tier and flag the trigger to upgrade
Check inherited or legacy account features before relying on the plan name
Read trial terms and flag the date payment must be added
inputs: brand brain: budget and team capacity
brand brain: catalogue size and SKU complexity
founder_sees: Which platform and plan to build on, and why, with the real yearly cost.

name: Set up store foundation and account security
what: Configures the account a brand will keep for years: owner email, legal identity, currency and unit defaults, staff roles, two-factor authentication and agency access windows.
encompasses: Register under an email the business permanently controls
Enter exact legal identity before payments or tax
Set currency, region and units once before any price is entered
Turn on two-factor authentication before activating payments
Set custom staff roles and time-bound agency collaborator access
Keep every payment key out of files, prompts and chat
founder_sees: The account is owned, secured and free of leftover agency access.

name: Set up domain, DNS and brand-domain defense
what: Buys or connects the store's domain, points DNS correctly for the platform and for sender authentication, and registers the near-miss domains a squatter would use.
encompasses: Never launch on the default platform domain
Filter candidate names by brandability rules
Weigh platform registrar against a neutral one for portability
Reuse the DNS workflow for sender domain authentication
Register matching TLDs beyond .com
founder_sees: The domain and its DNS records are ready, with squatters blocked.

name: Select, vet and safely edit the theme
what: Picks a theme against a written feature list, vets it on product and mobile views, and enforces a duplicate-before-edit workflow so live changes never touch the production theme directly.
encompasses: List required sections and features before browsing themes
Vet a theme on PDP, mobile and developer quality, not the homepage
Decide free vs paid theme from the feature list
Duplicate the theme before every edit round
Use theme or section-level CSS instead of core file edits
Verify every change on the live URL, not only the editor preview
Know which edits autosave and which need an explicit save

external_write.surface: shopify theme | woocommerce theme | custom site repo

founder_sees: Which theme to use and a safe way to change it without breaking the live store.

name: Guardrail AI build-agent sessions
what: Writes the input brief and change plan before an AI coding agent touches the storefront, batches one change per prompt, previews privately and QAs every AI-authored section as a draft, never as finished work.
encompasses: Give the build agent real brand inputs, not a bare prompt
Let the agent interview and propose a plan before building
Ask for one storefront change per prompt and verify it live
Preview privately, never on the public URL
Treat AI theme and copy output as a draft needing manual QA
Check AI-generated PDP claims against the real product and ad rules
Plan long sessions around a possible usage-limit pause
inputs: brand brain: full product and policy record
trigger: event: theme or page build starts
founder_sees: AI-built pages and code are checked and safe before they go live.

name: Build product catalogue data
what: Completes every required product field: type, weight, cost, variants, SKUs, images and swatches, so orders, tax, shipping and margin reporting all work from day one.
encompasses: Match product type to how it is really sold and fulfilled
Turn on inventory tracking and give every product a SKU
Enter cost per item so margin reports work
Build variant options and price every row
Verify swatch accuracy and add hex values
Set digital download limits and gift card fulfilment correctly
Group gallery images by variant
founder_sees: Every product is complete enough to sell, ship and be taxed correctly.

name: Build collection, tag and menu architecture
what: Decides manual versus smart collections, sets tag discipline so filters work, and builds a navigation menu shoppers can use in 2 to 3 clicks.
encompasses: Decide collections first, then tag to match
Choose smart collection conditions (any vs all) deliberately
Delete or rename default collections before launch
Build menus around how shoppers think
Cap storefront navigation to 7 items or fewer
Keep breadcrumb navigation on across PDP and collection
founder_sees: The menu and collections a shopper can actually navigate.

name: Draft legal and policy pages
what: Produces shipping, returns, privacy and terms pages from the brand's real practice, never a bare template, and routes them to a human for legal sign-off before publish.
encompasses: Create every required legal and info page before launch
Edit every placeholder in a policy template
Write real shipping terms with a cross-border duties disclosure
Configure self-serve returns after the policy is published
Point checkout's agree-box at the real terms page
Get a human legal sign-off on AI-drafted policy text
inputs: brand brain: shipping and returns practice
founder_sees: Draft policy pages ready for a lawyer's sign-off, not a launch blocker.

name: Configure payment gateways and go-live test
what: Sets up the primary and a second payment method, regional methods for key markets, fraud and capture rules, and proves the whole path with a sandboxed then a real refunded order before removing the storefront password.
encompasses: Verify identity documents exactly for payment activation
Add a second gateway and regional payment methods
Set capture timing and turn on fraud screening
Test every gateway in sandbox, then one real order and refund

Screen for fake or high-risk orders with fraud signals (mismatched billing and shipping, high-risk BIN, order velocity); screen for fake cash-on-delivery orders where COD is offered as a market option
Set the card statement descriptor to the real brand name
Re-check the gateway is live right before removing the password
founder_sees: Payments are live, tested with a real refunded order, and fraud screening is on.

name: Configure shipping zones and rates
what: Builds shipping zones, rates, free-shipping thresholds and package weights from the brand's real margin and fulfilment ability, and tests every rate bracket before launch.
encompasses: Give every target country an explicit rate
Set the free shipping threshold from margin and AOV, and show it
Use per-item, table or class rates when cost scales with weight
Keep each country in exactly one zone
Assign a fulfilment location to every zone
Add a delivery time estimate to every rate label
Test carts at every rate bracket edge before launch
founder_sees: Shipping rates that match the brand's margin and are tested at every edge.

name: Configure tax by jurisdiction
what: Sets tax display, calculation basis and per-jurisdiction rows or an automated tax service, after the brand's obligations are confirmed with a real tax professional, and tests one product per class in at least two regions.
encompasses: Establish real tax obligations with a professional first
Enable the platform tax service per registered region
Decide inclusive vs exclusive display once, consistently
Decide the tax basis (origin/destination) per state's rule
Decide whether tax applies to shipping, per jurisdiction
Test one product per tax class in at least 2 regions
founder_sees: Tax is set up correctly and re-checked whenever the catalogue or zones change.

name: Set up multi-market and localization
what: Groups target countries into markets by shared tax treatment, sets per-market currency, catalogue, theme content and price rounding, and verifies the plan actually supports it before promising it to the founder.
encompasses: Group countries by tax treatment, not geography
Verify the plan supports per-market theme customization
Add languages with auto-translate plus human review
Build a per-market catalogue that excludes products where needed
Nest a country as a sub-market when treatment matches
Round converted per-market prices to a natural ending
founder_sees: A market plan for each country, with the tax, price and content that actually apply there.

name: Audit and govern the app and script stack
what: Vets every app before install, removes ones with no clear revenue role, consolidates duplicates, and removes residual code after uninstalls, keeping the stack lean by policy, not habit.
encompasses: Launch with a lean stack and add one app at a time
Vet an app before install against ratings and a before/after test
Prefer native platform features over duplicate third-party apps
Enable an app's theme embed right after install
Consolidate apps doing the same job
Search for and remove residual code after every uninstall
founder_sees: Which apps are worth keeping, and which are slowing the store for no return.

name: Run pre-launch QA and launch sequencing
what: Follows a dependency-ordered launch checklist, verifies every step with the action a real customer would take, and only removes the storefront password after the full checklist passes.
encompasses: Follow the dependency-ordered launch sequence step by step
Close every step with a real customer action, not a settings check
Verify every product is buyable end to end
Confirm confirmation and shipping emails actually arrive
Run a full mobile QA pass on the live storefront
Verify the logged-out storefront in incognito, clicking every element
Launch imperfect once the checklist passes, then collect feedback
founder_sees: A pass/fail launch checklist and a clear go or no-go call.

name: Monitor post-launch store hygiene
what: Runs scheduled housekeeping after launch: inventory reconciliation, support-ticket root-cause classification, broken-link and redirect sweeps, and re-verification of tracking and gateway status after any change.
encompasses: Reconcile platform inventory against real stock weekly in month one
Classify support tickets weekly to find thin pages or policies
Re-run shipping and tax checks whenever a product, zone or app changes
Confirm review-request automation is actually sending
Confirm the payout bank account matches the region's deposit type
Find and fix broken links to images, CSS and JS
Use 301 redirects only, and remove redirect chains
founder_sees: A weekly list of small things quietly going wrong on the store.

name: Set up subscription, loyalty, wishlist and B2B features
what: Adds subscription, bundle, loyalty, wishlist or a B2B price list and net-terms path only when the product and margin genuinely fit repeat purchase or wholesale, and builds the UI for it.
encompasses: Choose subscriptions or bundles only when the product fits repeat purchase
Add loyalty only when repeat purchase matters to margin
Add a wishlist so shoppers can save for later
Build a separate B2B path with price list and minimum order
Never pre-select a subscription option in a quiz or checkout
Build a distinct hypothesis set for pause, skip, swap and cancel flows
founder_sees: Whether a subscription, loyalty or B2B feature is worth building, and its spec.

name: Install tracking and build the founder's reporting cadence
what: Installs analytics through native integrations, sets UTM auto-match rules, picks an attribution model deliberately, and builds one repeatable morning report instead of scattered dashboards.
encompasses: Install and verify analytics tracking through the native integration
Read analytics over a multi-month window, not one day
Set up UTM auto-match so campaign traffic attributes itself
Choose an attribution model deliberately for the question being asked
Build a repeatable morning marketing report
Use the analytics AI query tool for plain-language questions
Read sales by gross, net, discount and channel as separate views
founder_sees: One daily report instead of five dashboards, built from clean tracking.

name: Configure cart and checkout base settings
what: Sets guest checkout, minimal fields, consent separation, checkout branding, coupon caps and order limits so the base checkout is fast and safe before any CRO test touches it.
encompasses: Keep guest checkout on, never force account creation
Set checkout fields to the minimum needed
Separate transactional from marketing consent
Brand the checkout within plan limits
Enable coupons with per-user limit and max spend cap
Set a per-order quantity cap when stock is scarce
Turn on exactly one abandoned-checkout email owner
founder_sees: A checkout with no unnecessary friction and no duplicate emails.

name: Build homepage and PDP theme modules
what: Builds the reusable theme-level sections that make up the homepage and PDP: fixed section order, hero focal points, sticky add-to-cart, size charts, FAQ tabs and trust blocks, each backed by a real reason to include it.
encompasses: Build the homepage in a fixed, conversion-focused section order
Set a focal point on hero and banner images
Add a size chart to every sized product
Add collapsible FAQ tabs built from real tickets and reviews
Keep add-to-cart sticky on mobile
Reuse the trust section on the PDP below the buy area
Add a free-shipping progress bar that updates live in cart

external_write.surface: shopify theme | woocommerce theme | custom site repo

founder_sees: The reusable page sections that make up the storefront, each with a reason.

name: Route out-of-scope setup findings to the owning specialist
what: Some findings in a store-setup audit are not the site's job: email flows, organic social cadence, product validation and supplier copy belong to other specialists. This capability packages those findings and hands them off instead of quietly dropping them.
encompasses: Flag a lifecycle automation gap (welcome, cart recovery, win-back) for the Lifecycle specialist
Flag an organic social cadence gap for the Organic and search specialist
Flag a pre-build product validation need for the Product specialist
Flag a VIP or segmentation campaign for the Lifecycle specialist
Package the observed condition and evidence, not a finished brief
founder_sees: A short note saying which other specialist should look at this, and why.

name: Capture a speed baseline and find the root cause
what: Records the ad landing page and top product page with speed_lab.record, replays them on a throttled mobile profile with speed_lab.measure, and finds the single biggest cause of slowness before proposing many small fixes.
encompasses: Record every response of the real page before touching anything
Measure 3 runs on a Pixel 5 profile, slow 4G, 4x CPU, take the median
Fix the page paid ads land on before any other page
Test every template type, not only the homepage
Cross-check a suspicious result with a second tool
Confirm the test actually saw the latest change before trusting it
inputs: brand brain: top paid landing page and PDP URLs
founder_sees: The one thing making the page slow, proven with a real measurement, not a guess.

name: Cut image weight
what: Finds oversized, wrongly formatted or non-lazy images across the store and produces the exact resize, compress, format and loading fixes needed, with before/after byte counts.
encompasses: Check images first; do not trust automatic platform compression alone
Resize to about 2,000px before upload, hold hard size ceilings
Use JPEG for photos, PNG only for transparency, never GIF
Let the platform/CDN deliver WebP or AVIF
Lazy-load below the fold, force eager load on hero and first-card images
Add width/height or aspect-ratio to prevent layout shift
Sweep the media library for multi-MB non-product images
inputs: connector: shopify admin | woocommerce media library
outputs: image fix list with before/after sizes
founder_sees: Exactly which images are too heavy and the fix for each.

name: Govern third-party scripts and app tags for speed
what: Inventories every script route (theme, app embed, tag manager, hardcoded), defers or delays non-critical ones behind interaction, and removes dead or duplicate ones, without breaking tracking.
encompasses: Inventory every route a script uses before touching any of them
Add defer to blocking scripts, test the exact feature they power
Delay non-critical widget scripts until first interaction
On Shopify, use the content_for_header delay override, never comment it out
Never change pixel loading without testing every event on and off
Load app assets only on templates where the widget appears
Turn off unused Shopify app embeds
founder_sees: Which scripts to delay or remove, and proof tracking still fires.

name: Fix font loading
what: Subsets fonts to the characters actually used, serves them as self-hosted WOFF2 with font-display swap, limits variation count, and matches the fallback font's metrics to prevent a layout jump on swap.
encompasses: Keep about 3 font variations at most
Self-host fonts as WOFF2 instead of calling Google Fonts
Add font-display: swap to every @font-face rule
Style the fallback font to match size and line height
On a framework storefront, subset fonts to the characters needed
founder_sees: The font fix that cuts megabytes without changing how the brand looks.

name: Diagnose and fix layout shift (CLS)
what: Names the exact element causing layout shift per template, reserves space for anything that arrives after first paint, and fixes conflicting CSS instead of papering over the symptom.
encompasses: Diagnose the exact element causing the shift before fixing it
Reserve space for every element that arrives after first paint
Fix contradicting CSS rules and move late inline styles into the head
Remove entrance effects and fade-ins on in-view elements
On a framework storefront, reserve fixed-height containers for late content
founder_sees: Exactly which element is jumping, and the fix.

name: Diagnose and fix LCP
what: Names the LCP element per template and runs the standard fix order: un-lazy, de-animate, compress, preload, then cut the blocking script hiding it, proving the fix with averaged before/after runs.
encompasses: Name the LCP element per template before fixing it
Run the fix order: un-lazy, de-animate, compress, preload, cut blocking scripts
If the image downloads fast but paints late, find the hiding script
Check TTFB before blaming the image
Preload only the LCP image with high fetch priority
Design the above-the-fold section so the biggest element is text where possible
founder_sees: The exact largest element and the fix order that will move LCP.

name: Fix interactivity (INP) on key interactions
what: Cuts main-thread JavaScript blocking add-to-cart, variant pickers, filters and search autocomplete, and confirms the fix with a real tap test, not just a score.
encompasses: Cut JavaScript on the main thread for add-to-cart, pickers, filters
Treat search autocomplete lag as an everyday INP issue
Confirm a fix with a tap test on Add to Cart, not just the score
Track cart-completion time separately from INP
Move compatible scripts to a web worker at rebuild time
founder_sees: Why tapping Add to Cart feels slow, and the fix.

name: Configure caching, CDN and hosting
what: Verifies caching and compression from response headers, excludes cart/checkout/account pages from the cache, sets long TTLs on static assets, and matches the hosting tier to real order volume.
encompasses: Verify caching from response headers, not a plugin's settings page
Never cache cart, checkout, account or any visitor-specific page
Cache static assets long-term with versioned names
Defer session creation until first add-to-cart or login
Set up a CDN targeting an 80%+ hit rate
Match hosting tier to monthly order volume
Call the host with 4 key questions only after front-end fixes are measured
founder_sees: Whether caching is actually working, and a short brief for the host if not.

name: Prepare peak-event load readiness
what: Lists every dynamic step at risk under a big-sale spike, load-tests them ahead of time, considers a waiting room for a limited drop, and freezes app installs and theme changes during the window.
encompasses: List dynamic steps at risk of a peak-event slowdown
Load-test the at-risk steps before the event
Consider a virtual waiting room for a limited-inventory drop
Freeze app installs and theme changes during the peak window
Keep a tested rollback path ready before the event
founder_sees: Whether the store can survive the next big sale, and what to freeze beforehand.

name: Minify, split and inline critical code
what: Minifies and splits CSS/JS by page type, inlines complete critical CSS per template, and delays non-critical CSS (modals, drawers, filters), only after images and scripts are already fixed.
encompasses: Minify and split CSS/JS by page type, only after images and scripts are done
Delay non-critical CSS with the media=print trick
Make inlined critical CSS complete for every visually different template
On WooCommerce, unload cart/checkout/block styles from pages without a cart
Fix render-blocking JavaScript ahead of the main image
founder_sees: The code-splitting plan and why it comes last, not first.

name: Tune headless and framework storefront performance
what: Applies framework-specific fixes on a custom or headless storefront: image priority hints, server-side rendering of the buy box, trimmed API payloads, and code-split UI components.
encompasses: Mark only the LCP image as priority, set sizes on small images
Server-render the buy box and top collection tiles
Return only the fields a tile or page actually needs from the API
Code-split and lazy-load non-critical UI components
Set a long image cache TTL with a correct Vary header
founder_sees: Framework-specific fixes for a custom or headless build.

name: Write the speed developer brief and host brief
what: Turns every diagnosed fix into a brief with a pass threshold, rollback plan, dependencies and who does it, so a developer can execute without guessing, following speed_lab.build_founder_page's format.
encompasses: Write every fix as a plan with pass threshold, rollback and dependencies
State the fix in plain terms: what, needs, tradeoff, who and how long
Share the PageSpeed report's own link instead of relaying findings by hand
Write a host brief with the 4 key questions instead of guessing server settings
Sequence fixes: content before infrastructure
inputs: diagnosed fixes from SITE-C22 to SITE-C31
founder_sees: One plain-English page: what to fix, what it needs, the tradeoff, who does it.

name: Run automated speed regression monitoring
what: Runs a speed check before any new feature or app ships and on a monthly schedule, holding a page-weight and script-count budget, and flags a regression the moment it appears.
encompasses: Re-audit speed on a monthly schedule and hold a page weight budget
Run a speed check on any new feature or app before it ships
Automate speed testing on a schedule
Add third-party script count to the speed budget as its own number
Wait about 28 days of field data before judging a fix worked
Read field and lab data as different things, fix from lab first
founder_sees: A monthly trend line and an alert the moment something new gets slow.

name: Run compliance and claims QA on page copy
what: Checks every page, advertorial and quiz against the brand's proof file before it ships: no invented people, testimonials or studies, every number computed in code, every image real, every claim tiered and sourced.
encompasses: Ban invented spokespeople, testimonials and comment sections
Add a disclosure label to every advertorial or quiz page
Audit every claim, number and endorsement against the brand's proof file
Compute every saving or lift number in code, never from memory
Use competitor and swipe pages for structure and mood only
Only use before-and-after images that are real and category-allowed
Only claim exclusivity after checking it live
Never show different prices for the same SKU to different shoppers at once
founder_sees: Every claim on the page traced to something real, before it goes live.

name: Design traffic-to-page-type routing and funnel architecture
what: Decides where an ad or search click should land, PDP, advertorial, quiz, sales page or campaign page, based on the SKU's awareness stage and price point, and builds the funnel's page sequence.
encompasses: Send high-intent or simple-product traffic straight to the PDP
Put an educating page between the ad and PDP for cold or skeptical traffic
Build the advertorial only after a winning ad or written research exists
Pick the format by the buyer's main obstacle
Classify each page's traffic awareness stage before writing the top
Build a dedicated single-product campaign page for paid traffic
Choose format by traffic awareness level
inputs: brand brain: avatar and awareness stage
trigger: event: new campaign or SKU launch
founder_sees: Which page type this campaign should land on, and why.

name: Audit message match from ad to page to checkout
what: Checks that the ad's exact promise, persona, price, guarantee and CTA wording carry through unbroken from the ad to the landing page to the cart and checkout, and re-runs the check whenever creative changes.
encompasses: Mirror the ad's exact promise in the hero headline
Continue the ad's story; never start a new one
Keep one persona consistent end to end
Match page length to how much the ad already sold
Match the CTA label to where it sends traffic
Keep price, discount, guarantee and shipping identical throughout
Re-run the check whenever ad creative changes
founder_sees: Whether the page still says what the ad promised.

name: Build and score the hero section
what: Writes the hero in a fixed 6-part order (proof, headline, subhead, CTA, FUD, image) and scores the headline on outcome-specificity, then places FUD reducers next to every CTA.
encompasses: Build the hero in the fixed 6-part order
Write the headline as the outcome this SKU delivers, never a category label
Score the headline against a tested formula and the outcome rule
Write the subhead to explain how, never repeat the headline
Keep hero body to 2-3 sentences or 3-4 bullets
Show 2 verifiable proof forms above the fold
Place real FUD reducers next to every CTA
Use a hero image or video that shows the promise
founder_sees: A drafted, scored hero section ready for the founder to approve.

name: Optimize the PDP buy-box and first screen
what: Fits the PDP's first-screen elements, price, proof, CTA, variant picker and delivery info, on the brand's real mobile device, and adds subscribe-and-save, delivery ETA and local payment trust signals where they fit the SKU.
encompasses: Fit the fixed first-screen elements on the brand's main mobile device
Place every control next to the element it changes
Add a subscribe-and-save selector for consumable SKUs
Show delivery ETA or a ZIP code and USPS address serviceability check near the buy box (pincode serviceability check where the brand sells in India)
Show local payment methods beside the FUD reducers
Answer what, why this one, why now and why trust you above the fold
Put reviews, savings, sticky add-to-cart and gallery next to the buy box
founder_sees: The buy-box layout that fits on the brand's real phone.

name: Write on-page persuasion copy
what: Writes value props, how-it-works steps, honest comparisons, FAQ and closers in the customer's own words, mined from reviews and tickets, scannable and below a tenth-grade reading level.
encompasses: Write each value prop as a benefit heading with the feature as support
Show how the product works in 3-4 steps ending at the outcome
Build an honest comparison against the 2-3 real alternatives
Build the FAQ from that SKU's own tickets and negative reviews
Write section headings as the shopper's payoff, not a department label
Write in the customer's own words, mined from reviews and tickets
Rewrite feature bullets as outcome-first copy with a so-what test
Quantify claims with a true number wherever one exists
founder_sees: Page copy in the customer's own words, checked against real tickets and reviews.

name: Design proof and social-proof placement
what: Maps every testimonial, badge, press quote and video to the one objection it answers, scatters proof through the page instead of stacking it once, and builds a real post-purchase survey to keep collecting it.
encompasses: Show the trust badge shoppers actually trust for that channel
Map every testimonial to 1 named objection it must answer
Scatter proof throughout the page instead of stacking it once
Add phone-shot UGC and a short founder video for trust-led SKUs
Build 3 proof layers on a presell page: mechanism, social, demonstration
Collect proof on purpose with a short post-purchase survey
Pair every press logo with a short attributed quote
Check review dates for suspicious clustering before trusting them
founder_sees: Where each piece of proof goes, and which doubt it answers.

name: Design offer, bundle and price presentation
what: Builds bundle tiers with real per-tier savings shown in money, anchors price against a real sourced comparison, and designs post-purchase and cart-level offers priced by contribution per buyer.
encompasses: Show bundle savings in money, in the tier headline
Offer 3 bundle tiers, each with an image and one honest badge
Anchor price against a real, sourced comparison, never invented
Set equal step savings across tiers to steer to the target tier
Present a bundle as a value stack against summed item value
Judge every funnel step by contribution per buyer, not take rate
Pick the post-purchase upsell by more-of-same or next-problem logic
founder_sees: A bundle or offer design with the real margin math shown.

name: Write compliant urgency, scarcity and guarantee copy
what: Writes urgency and scarcity only when it is true and phrased as risk rather than a fake count, wires a live low-stock display to real inventory, and presents the guarantee word-for-word matched to policy.
encompasses: Use urgency and scarcity only when true, phrased as risk not a fake count
Build a real-time low-stock display wired to live inventory
Present the guarantee as confidence, matched word for word to policy
Close long pages with 2 honest options: leave, or try risk-free
Use a soft demand-implying CTA only when stock is genuinely limited
founder_sees: Urgency and guarantee copy that is true, checked against live stock.

name: Remove navigation and interaction friction on conversion surfaces
what: Strips navigation to essentials on single-offer pages, opens a cart drawer instead of reloading, fires pop-ups only on intent signals, and repairs dead controls, blockers and coupon-field clutter.
encompasses: Strip navigation to logo, cart and 1 CTA on campaign pages
Open a cart drawer on add-to-cart instead of reloading
Fire pop-ups only on intent signals, never in the first 3-5 seconds
Fix or remove false affordances and dead controls
Remove the cart discount-code box when no promotion is live
Repair popups, chat widgets or cookie bars covering add-to-cart
Reveal extra form fields only after the first is filled
founder_sees: Which controls are broken or in the way, and the fix.

name: Build and QA pages mobile-first
what: Builds and reviews every page against the brand's own device split, checks every screen width in responsive mode, keeps mobile forms to 4 fields, and never hides critical content behind a mobile-only carousel.
encompasses: Build and review every page mobile-first, on the brand's own device split
Pin the PDP CTA on mobile with live price, without covering the selector
Never hide reviews or content behind a carousel/accordion on mobile
Shrink mobile chrome so no oversized logo buries the headline
Cut mobile forms to 4 fields or fewer with visible labels
Check every screen width in responsive mode before sending traffic
Put about 90% of CRO effort on mobile
founder_sees: Proof the page works on the phone widths real shoppers actually use.

name: Run the advertorial research and drafting pipeline
what: Gathers the research base, ranks pains, tests the big idea's uniqueness, drafts in the proven structure with AI, then runs a structured tighten pass and scrubs every invented fact before design.
encompasses: Gather a full research base before drafting
Rank candidate pains by urgency, scale and relevance
Test the big idea against the competitor set before drafting
Name the mechanism honestly with a checkable causal chain
Order the advertorial in the 14-block sequence
Write a why-nothing-else-worked block naming real alternatives
Draft with AI from the research base, then scrub every invented fact
Run a structured tighten pass before design
founder_sees: A drafted advertorial with every fact checked against the brand record.

name: Design, build and route a quiz funnel
what: Writes a full quiz spec, question by question, tests the hook questions first, inserts real nurture screens, builds the results page from the shopper's own answers, and routes answers to the matching offer.
encompasses: Cut every quiz question that has no clear job
Test the first 3 questions before anything else
Open with the least invasive, most important question
Insert a real info screen about every 3-5 questions
Start length at 8-12 questions
Build the results page to show the shopper's own answers and 1 CTA
Route each answer to its matching page or offer
Judge on completion rate and downstream purchase together
founder_sees: A complete quiz spec, ready to hand to a builder.

name: Build the sales-page, order-page and post-purchase upsell funnel
what: Builds a high-AOV sales page with its 8 must-haves, a low-friction order page with real order bumps, and a post-purchase upsell timed at peak emotion and priced by contribution per buyer.
encompasses: Build the sales page with its 8 must-haves, from scored headline to credibility
Let copy and proof carry the sale; design removes friction only
Build a low-friction order page with obvious fields and real order bumps
